title.label: iPhone Duo adaptation and text summarizing

content.label:
On the iPhone Duo, there is no Action Button, which makes it impossible to use a Shortcut to dictate and insert text directly. Please consider adapting the app to the iPhone Duo’s screens and improving its integration with Shortcuts.

Thank you for creating such a great product! I really appreciate your work and hope you’ll continue improving Russian language support.

I’d also love to see a text summarization feature. It would be great to dictate a long text and then choose how much to shorten it — from a slightly condensed version to just the main idea, while preserving the key points.
